purpose: Credit billing SSOT (v0.48 Phase 2): THREE buckets on the user row — allowance (monthly, reset) → purchased (packs, never expire) → metered (postpaid `api` plan, capped, gated on an active subscription) — spent by ONE guarded SQL statement in preAuthorize; settle/refund reverse bucket-by-bucket; every mutation writes a credit_events journal row in the same transaction (sprint v0.45 T1). Grants: applyMonthlyGrant RESETS the allowance (closes the GREATEST leak), applyUpgradeGrant GREATEST on the allowance, clawback purchased-only. Sweep helpers listUnreportedUsage/consumeReported.
notes: preAuthorize uses updateMany with gte guard — atomic compare-and-decrement, no overspend. applyMonthlyGrant accepts {client:tx} for webhook transactional use.

purpose: Caches the final origin-blind /api/search JSON payload in KV (Upstash/Vercel KV), keyed by SHA-256 of result-affecting inputs; fail-open.

Cross-adapter ranked result list (unified view) — pools all sections, sorts by _score, paginates by group (20+10), triggers remote load-more when local pool exhausted.

App-wide defaults — STORAGE_NS, HISTORY_MAX, page sizes, REGION_ORDER, DEFAULT_CURATED_JOURNALS, DEFAULT_SETTINGS (all search/source/key defaults).

Pure memoized derivation of filteredSections from sectionStates — applies global low-confidence gate, all facet filters, and sort.
Auth-aware search history — localStorage + DB sync on sign-in; add (dedup+cap at 50), remove, clear.

purpose: Auth-aware saved library — localStorage + DB sync on sign-in; toggle (add/remove), clear, isInLibrary check.
Fan-out search engine — fires all enabled adapters in parallel, runs cross-adapter dedup + BM25F scoring + confidence gate, manages sectionStates.
notes: No AbortController — stale adapter responses from a superseded search can land in state.

Once every adapter settles, scores the pool on-device (lib.semantic) and returns a copy of sectionStates with `_sim` on each result, ordered by it per section; incremental on load-more, resets on new search, clears on toggle-off, falls back to native order on error.
notes: Revived v0.49 (sprint_log_v0_49 §2) from docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/ — rewritten, not restored verbatim. No RRF/slider any more: pure semantic order behind ONE toggle (settings.semanticSearch). App.jsx layers rerankedStates over useSearch state and holds resultsReady until status is done|error.

purpose: Auth-aware settings — localStorage read/write + DB sync on sign-in; manages adapter enable/disable; one-time v.31 migration.

Shared localStorage↔DB sync plumbing for the auth-aware hooks — load-on-mount, sync-from-DB on sign-in (DB wins), first-time push, and fire-and-forget mutation writes. Shapes injected via a config object.

purpose: Factory function createLauncher() — enforces the launcher object shape (id, name, tagline, region, archiveType, contentType, buildUrl).
Registry of 23 external archive launchers (no queryable API — opens pre-filled search in new tab), grouped by region.
Client-side admin gate — isAdmin(user) checks user.email against VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS env var (comma-separated).
Thin generic fetch wrapper with credentials:include and Content-Type:application/json for all API routes.
Browser Auth.js client: getSession, signIn (CSRF form submit), signOut, getCsrfToken for /api/auth/* endpoints.
notes: signIn uses postForm (hidden form submit) not fetch() — required for Auth.js v5 CSRF + cross-origin OAuth redirect. getCsrfToken exported for Phase 4 SIWE.

purpose: Client-side wrapper for POST /api/checkout; returns {url} for Stripe redirect or {error, code} on failure.
notes: credentials:include ensures session cookie is sent. Never constructs Stripe objects on the client side.

purpose: Generates MLA 9, APA 7, CSL-JSON, BibTeX, and RIS citation strings from NCR records; returns segment arrays for MLA/APA to enable inline italic rendering without an HTML parser.
notes: Never called at search time — only on render (MLA/APA display) and user action (export dispatcher).

purpose: Result identity and deduplication: doiKey (strongest), titleFingerprint (fuzzy same-paper); dedupFirstWins for streaming (first-occurrence wins), dedupHighestScore for pooled (highest _score wins).
notes: v0.42: dedupHighestScore replacement is now O(1) via a posMap (F-206), and a collision ENRICHES the survivor with the loser's better fields via mergeRecords (F-210, the sprint's "F-208") instead of discarding it. Pooled path only — dedupFirstWins (streaming) cannot merge. Covered by src/lib/dedup.test.js.

purpose: nDCG@10, MRR, and Recall@N metrics engine for the F2 Gold-Set Regression Harness in the admin console; grades results against a DOI/title → relevance-grade label map.
notes: Unit-tested in goldSetMetrics.test.js. Imported by components/admin/GoldSetHarness.jsx — NOT orphaned. Not called during live search. v0.44: recall@k stays meaningful post-teardown; nDCG/MRR measure upstream order only.

purpose: Clusters book-chapter results under their container/book title for the source-view layout; non-chapter results pass through as single-item groups.
notes: Render-time only — not called during scoring or dedup.

purpose: Utility functions: reconstructAbstract (OpenAlex inverted index), truncate (word-boundary safe), stripHtml.
localStorage-backed search history CRUD — add (dedup+cap at HISTORY_MAX=50), remove, load, clear.

Isomorphic identifier resolution (detectIdType, resolveIds, canonicalDoi) over the NCBI PMC ID Converter, with a shared token-bucket limiter (key 'ncbi_eutils'); feeds the pre-dedup DOI canonicalizer (v0.43 T2.2, attacks v0.35 D5 fragmentation) and /api/ids.
notes: Clean-room from neuromechanist/opencite id_converter.py + base.py (MIT). No Node-only imports — fetch/performance.now are global in Node ≥18 and browsers. Mixed-type batches rejected by NCBI; inputs are split into homogeneous groups with explicit idtype before each request. 429 returned as a JSON body (not just HTTP status) — parsed defensively; the whole batch is treated as unresolved rather than throwing. Process-local token bucket: limits per warm Vercel instance, not globally (same caveat as adapterHealth.js).

purpose: Maps ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, and full English language names to a canonical {code, display} pair; returns null for undetermined/undifferentiated codes.
notes: Used by adapters to normalise language codes from API responses.

purpose: localStorage-backed library CRUD — add/remove/has/load/clear, keyed by DOI or source:id.
Client-side ring buffer logger (500 entries) — structured [opencite:adapter:event] format; installDebugLog() activates buffering + global error handlers for admins.
notes: Buffer only active when installDebugLog() is called (admin sign-in). Distinct from api/_shared/log.js (server-side).

purpose: Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion: scale-free merger of native, lexical, and semantic rank lists; also provides buildNativeRanks (per-source dense rank map) and nativeWeight (pool-size-aware native share).
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: Used by hooks.useSemanticRerank (client). Not yet called by api.search (server) — F-209 open gap.

purpose: BM25F content-relevance scorer (SSOT): tokenises title/abstract/keywords with NFKD normalisation, computes per-pool IDF, applies phrase/proximity boosts, capability-gated citation tiebreak and thin-source prior; also exports hasContentMatch and applyConfidenceGate.
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: D1/D2/D5 are FIXED in current source. D3/D4 partially fixed (client UI path uses RRF; server path still raw BM25F). IDF is per-pool over 14-45 docs — degenerate by design until v0.35 T2 server extension.

purpose: v0.47 free-tier web search quota: a per-UTC-day localStorage counter (FREE_WEB_DAILY_SEARCHES) for callers whose plan lacks unlimited web search; soft, client-side only.
notes: Reads hasUnlimitedWebSearch from plans.js (SSOT). Bypassable by design (Shahbaz, v0.47).

purpose: On-device embedder client: owns the embed.worker singleton, builds the title+abstract+keywords text (700-char budget), prefixes the QUERY with the arctic-embed query instruction, embeds query+docs in one batch and returns a cosine similarity per result; per-id embedding cache for load-more.
notes: Revived v0.49 (sprint_log_v0_49 §2) from docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/ — rewritten, not restored verbatim. Model: Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-xs (22 MB quantized, CLS pooling, English-only, Apache-2.0). Cannot run server-side (Web Worker) — F-205 remains the documented API gap.

purpose: Admin A/B runner: runs one query through the browser pipeline twice (toggle off / on) via the same adapters + policy as the live app, dedups in registry order, returns both ordered lists, per-arm gold-set metrics when labels exist, overlap@10, baseline-top-5 landing ranks and timings.
notes: No server call; both arms hit the sources from the browser like a normal search. There is no server-side query log — query lists come from the gold set, local history or paste.

purpose: Semantic-search policy SSOT: R1 queryForAdapter (stopword keyword rewrite for every source except OpenAlex), R2 optsForAdapter (100-deep OpenAlex first page), R3 orderBySimilarity; also interleaveLists (the v0.44 D-3 default order, shared by the unified list and the A/B harness).
notes: Pure functions, no network/model. Consumers: hooks.useSearch, components.UnifiedResultList, hooks.useSemanticRerank, lib.semanticCompare. Any future ranking change must go through here so the live app and the admin A/B cannot drift.

purpose: Namespaced localStorage wrapper — prefixes all keys with 'opencite:'; get/set/remove with JSON serialization and try/catch.
Score-side term expansion (original query to APIs unchanged): 16 hand-curated academic clusters (synchronous) + Moby Thesaurus II letter-keyed shards (async, CDN-fetched, shard-cached).
notes: Quarantined v0.44 (engine teardown, sprint_log_v0_44 D-4): source preserved at docs/wiki/99-Archive/_quarantine/v0_44_engine/. Virtual record kept so cross-refs resolve. Prior notes: MAX_MOBY_SYNS=24 cap. httpExecutor (v0.48): one HTTPS executor returning { status, headers, body|text } for every response; never throws on non-2xx so 402/401/429 bodies reach the agent. TLS-only; key never logged.
notes: v0.43: extended with client functions for /api/citations and /api/ids (searchCitations, resolveIds). Structural scan will pick up the new exports.

Prisma schema: User, Account, Session, VerificationToken, search_history, library_items, ApiKey, ApiUsage, ProcessedEvent, relevance_labels — all models for auth, billing, history, and gold-set.

Minimal Vite config: React plugin only. No aliases, chunks, proxy, or SSR.
